description: Cs₂NaAs₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Cs sites. In the first Cs site, Cs is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten As atoms. There are a spread of Cs-As bond distances ranging from 3.67-4.10 Å. In the second Cs site, Cs is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten As atoms. There are a spread of Cs-As bond distances ranging from 3.81-4.33 Å. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to six As atoms. There are a spread of Na-As bond distances ranging from 3.00-3.46 Å. There are seven inequivalent As sites. In the first As site, As is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Cs, one Na, and three As atoms. There are a spread of As-As bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.52 Å. In the second As site, As is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Cs, two equivalent Na, and two As atoms. The As-As bond length is 2.42 Å. In the third As site, As is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five Cs and two As atoms. There is one shorter (2.35 Å) and one longer (2.43 Å) As-As bond length. In the fourth As site, As is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to three Cs, one Na, and three As atoms. The As-As bond length is 2.44 Å. In the fifth As site, As is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to four Cs and three As atoms. The As-As bond length is 2.54 Å. In the sixth As site, As is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three Cs, one Na, and two As atoms. The As-As bond length is 2.35 Å. In the seventh As site, As is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two Cs, one Na, and three As atoms.
